# Qwen2.5 row repair, variant `_lr1e-4` (lr 0.0001)

<!-- repair tables: generated by src/qwen_repair.py, replaced on re-run -->

Training: 200 steps x batch 8 x 256-token windows = 409,600 tokens seen, Adam lr 0.0001, grad-norm clip 1.0, on 999,875 training characters per domain (1,106,792 mark-aware tokens available). Only the 1,578 dead rows (1.04% of the matrix) were trainable. 16 CPU threads; training 87 min, whole run 97 min.

**Check against the checkpoint: passed.** 1,578 embedding rows changed, 0 of them outside the dead set (max difference there 0); 289 of 289 other weight tensors bit-identical; output head still tied: True.
